risks: Concurrent execution can alter floating-point ordering and stochastic trajectories despite identical paired seeds. Scientific equivalence concerns paired energy medians, not trajectory identity; independent contexts and correctly assigned random streams are essential.

The absolute margins are baseline-only Monte Carlo standard errors derived from across-seed sample SD divided by sqrt(8), not published scientific tolerances or measured same-seed repeatability. Across-seed SD does not estimate paired-difference variance, so empirical power cannot be certified.

The conditional joint power lower bound of 0.8454893888558401 exceeds the 0.8 target only under the stated prospective assumption of independent seeds with per-seed probability at least 0.99 of falling strictly within each metric margin. This assumption is not established by the supplied measurements.

Ensemble concurrency requires independent scientific replicas. Shared mutable state, seed reuse across workers, missing replicas, output collisions or changed aggregation weights would invalidate the comparison. Preserve the one-input, eight-seed workload exactly.
